_meta.description: Registry of PREMIUM (proprietary metal-to-metal / gas-tight) tubular connection designations observed in real completion designs. This is a NAME + provenance registry only: dimensional and performance data (OD, ID, drift, joint efficiency, seal/pressure ratings, make-up torque, bending/compression limits) are PROPRIETARY, vendor-supplied per each vendor's public datasheet, and are deliberately left null here - NOT vendored, never fabricated (same policy as the API 5CT grade performance fields).
_meta.source: Connection designations parsed from the Volve open dataset (Equinor) WellCat completion models; these are the premium connections used on the Volve producer/injector strings. Equinor released the Volve dataset publicly, and each connection's specification is published on its vendor's public website. Refer any provenance query to Equinor's Volve open-data release and to the respective vendor.
_meta.policy: Registry recognises the connection NAME + (where unambiguous) the vendor. It asserts NO dimensions and NO ratings. For dimensional/performance data, consult the vendor's public connection datasheet. A null vendor means the brand owner was not asserted with confidence (not guessed).
_meta.citation: Volve open dataset (Equinor), WellCat completion models (connection designations only). Public vendor datasheets for specifications.
_meta.de_identified: Grade and connection designations are public vendor/industry identifiers; no operator, well, or individual identifiers are included.
